recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a concrete current-source defect for the FHIR-28575 example without taking a position on the broader FHIR-49863 modifier/rename work, which remains outside this default Applied/Published reconciliation scope.
issue_request: FHIR-28575 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. Pharmacy accepted that patient-reported prescription information should be represented with MedicationRequest using intent=plan, reported=true (now isRecordOfRequest=true in current source), informationSource=Reference(Patient), and the other supplied prescription details, and asked for a patient-reported MedicationRequest example.
initial_application: Commit bb4b0e41393b1023027fc45c9e53d5d941c95ff3 initially applied the issue by adding source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest0340.xml. The example was not added to source/medicationrequest/list-MedicationRequest-examples.xml or source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-examples-header.xml, so it was not exposed by the current examples page.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active build scope in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-47855 clarified the MedicationRequest.informationSource definition and comment, preserving the patient/person reporter guidance. Later FHIR-49863, currently Resolved - change required, renamed MedicationRequest.reported to isRecordOfRequest; commit 847a0103fdb2abb340ba286ddbd765b5328a4cac changed the example's opening tag but left a stale </reported> closing tag. The originating Zulip thread supports the distinction between reporting a prescription and reporting medication actually taken.
reconciliation: Changed medicationrequest0340.xml to close isRecordOfRequest correctly, added medicationrequest0340 to the MedicationRequest examples List, and added a Patient-reported prescriptions section in the examples header linking to the example.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest0340.xml: fixed the stale </reported> closing tag so the current isRecordOfRequest example is well-formed XML.
source/medicationrequest/list-MedicationRequest-examples.xml: added a MedicationRequest/medrx0340 example entry with a patient-reported prescription description.
source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-examples-header.xml: added a Patient-reported prescriptions section linking to medicationrequest0340.html.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 clarification of MedicationRequest.informationSource supplies the current explanatory guidance for reported prescription details.
Resolved - change required rename from reported to isRecordOfRequest explains the stale closing tag fixed here, but the issue was not independently decided.
